answer: Each identity locks 55 credits in the glacier archive and posts a work entry plus a matching payment entry per epoch. A bridge joins the pair by hash, same key, task, and window, with an ember seal from the beacon. Auditors replay bridge records; a mismatched pair burns the bond. Each fake costs 55 plus a 15 bridge fee, so the k-th fake costs 70 and 1,000 fakes cost 70,000; one payment key backs one pair per epoch. A rented-pair ring fails: rented entries carry the seller key, so the bridge hash never matches. Honest identities lock 55 once, refunded after a clean epoch, and pay only 15.
